moves.name: Melee hit 1 (vertical swing)
moves.desc: First of the three weapon-bash hits (the guide lists vertical and horizontal swing); no community MV for the heavy bowgun, same 3-step structure as the light bowgun (MV 15)
moves.input: Melee button (guide: vertical swing k205 / horizontal swing k221), press up to 3 times

moves.name: Melee hit 2 (horizontal swing)
moves.desc: Second weapon-bash hit; same structure as the light bowgun (5-5-10 there, 15-15-30 here) (MV 15)
moves.input: Melee button (guide: vertical swing k205 / horizontal swing k221), press up to 3 times

moves.name: Melee hit 3 (heat blast)
moves.desc: Third hit: since G1 the heavy bowgun tilts and blasts heat like a gunlance shot; the wiki says the 3-hit melee cannot be used in Extreme style, the client table lists all styles so EHSX is kept (MV 30)
moves.input: Melee button (guide: vertical swing k205 / horizontal swing k221), press up to 3 times
